oneSecondRead: A hunched violet zombie with a visible face, reaching unequal arms and a broken-crown shoulder bloom advances toward the fortress and shows weakening through posture before color.
worldRole: The readable standard zombie of the horde: a fair baseline pressure unit that lets players judge route, damage and defensive choices without borrowing the wall-breaking silhouette of a brute.
emotionalIntent: Immediately recognizable as a zombie, lightly unsettling and tenacious with a touch of awkward physical absurdity, but never realistic, graphic, tragic or gore-dependent.

orientation.front: A clearly undead violet rôdeur with a bowed visible head, dark expressive face cavity, hunched pear torso, unequal reaching arms and bent separated legs.
orientation.playerSide: No friendly socket, complete ring, service panel or repair affordance exists; the face and hands are target cues, not interaction controls.
orientation.threatSide: A forward cranial profile, open reaching hands, bent pursuit posture and a short pre-swipe draw-back communicate attack intent without giant fists or weapon props.

interactionZones.purpose: Declare zombie identity, facing and immediate hostile intent.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Bowed head, dark face cavity and broad jaw plane. Small high-contrast focal region inside a darker violet cranial mass. Color role: threat.

interactionZones.purpose: Carry violet faction identity and readable health posture.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Hunched pear torso with a rounded biological back. Dominant deep eggplant-to-plum mass. Color role: primary.

interactionZones.purpose: Show the standard zombie's close-range swipe family.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Medium open hands on unequal thick arm arcs. Hands separate from torso through value and negative space without becoming brighter focal points than the face. Color role: primary.

interactionZones.purpose: Carry distinctive horde identity and the single causal damage path.
interactionZones.requiredCue: One oblique crown-to-shoulder growth with broad facets. Mid-violet secondary mass separated from the darker body. Color role: secondary.

interactionZones.purpose: Make worsening health readable without blood, organs or detached body parts.
interactionZones.requiredCue: Collapsed shoulder, buckled knee and one widening break through the bloom. Pale dry inner fiber or dark void remains localized at the causal break. Color role: warning.

The head leads ahead of the hunched torso while both eyes, jaw plane, arms, legs and bloom remain complete. One open hand reaches toward the route and the other hangs lower, establishing the canonical asymmetry without injury.
invariants: Two-and-a-half by five-and-a-half by two-and-a-half bounds and feet-center pivot remain fixed.

The unit remains the standard rôdeur and never gains the giant fists, shoulder width, armor mass or wall-breaking promise of a brute.

collisionPromise: Keep the feet_center pivot, footprint and gameplay anchors identical in every generated state.
obligations: Reconstruct every primary and secondary component defined by this canon.
Produce every required state from the same component structure and stable anchors.
Preserve the one-second function, front, interaction, danger and state readings.
Record this canon ID and exact SHA-256 in the compliance envelope.
constraints: Dimensions are 2.5 x 5.5 x 2.5 studs with tolerance 0.005.
Pivot is feet_center and component anchors remain stable.
One UV set and one material slot maximum per production mesh component.
freedoms: bloom_facets: one to three broad facets inside the fixed crown-to-shoulder path. Adds individual horde variation without changing silhouette family, component count or damage topology.
gait_phase: full walk cycle inside shared head, shoulder, hand and foot pose limits. Prevents synchronized horde motion while preserving the same readable attack and state telegraphs.
broad_mottling: zero to two low-contrast plum value patches larger than a hand. Breaks uniformity without creating texture noise or carrying gameplay state.
